zh: 每一步的收益独立地从同一个分布里抽：r = μΔ + σ√Δ·ε，ε 已标准化为均值 0、方差 1（柯西除外）。
en: Each step's return is drawn independently from the same distribution: r = μΔ + σ√Δ·ε, where ε is standardized to mean 0 and variance 1 (except for the Cauchy).

zh: 分布
en: Distribution

zh: 正态
en: Normal

zh: Student-t（厚尾）
en: Student-t (heavy tails)

zh: 拉普拉斯（双指数）
en: Laplace (double exponential)

zh: 均匀
en: Uniform

zh: 两点（二叉树）
en: Two-point (binomial tree)

zh: 混合正态（偶发大跌）
en: Normal mixture (occasional crashes)

zh: 左偏（指数尾）
en: Left-skewed (exponential tail)

zh: 右偏（指数尾）
en: Right-skewed (exponential tail)

zh: 柯西（截断于 ±50 个尺度）
en: Cauchy (truncated at ±50 scale units)

zh: 期望收益 μ
en: Expected return μ

zh: 自由度 ν
en: Degrees of freedom ν

zh: 尾部指数；ν 越小尾越厚，ν ≤ 2 时方差不存在
en: Tail index; the smaller ν, the heavier the tails, and for ν ≤ 2 the variance does not exist

zh: 上涨概率 q
en: Up-move probability q

zh: q ≠ 0.5 时涨跌幅自动调整，保持均值和方差不变
en: When q ≠ 0.5 the sizes of the up and down moves adjust automatically so that the mean and the variance stay unchanged

zh: 大跌概率 w
en: Crash probability w

zh: 大跌幅度（σ 的倍数）
en: Crash size (multiples of σ)

zh: 大跌概率调大之后它有上限（否则整体的方差凑不成 1）：超过时按上限算，比如 w = 0.05 时最多约 3.9
en: Once the crash probability is raised, this size has an upper limit (otherwise the overall variance could not be made equal to 1): a value above the limit is replaced by the limit, for example at most about 3.9 when w = 0.05

zh: 柯西分布没有均值和方差：样本均值不收敛，加路径也不会让估计变准。这里截断在 ±50 个尺度，矩才存在。
en: The Cauchy distribution has no mean and no variance: the sample mean does not converge, and adding paths does not make the estimate any more accurate. Here it is truncated at ±50 scale units, which is the only reason the moments exist.

zh: 收益独立同分布，过去对未来没有任何预测力：任何择时规则的期望对数增长率都不会超过同等平均仓位的固定比例（每一步的期望收益则恰好相等）。最优的固定比例由 $\max_f \mathbb{E}\log(1+f\,r)$ 给出；$\sigma\sqrt{\Delta}$ 很小时 $f^*\approx\mu/\sigma^2$（二阶近似，无风险利率取 0，$\Delta$ 是一步的时长），厚尾和负偏会让它更小。分布没有下界时，严格地说只要 $f>1$ 就有正概率一步亏光：正态时这个概率小到看不见，Student-t 时在模拟里真的会出现。
en: Returns are i.i.d., so the past has no predictive power whatsoever for the future: the expected log growth rate of any timing rule cannot exceed that of the fixed fraction with the same average position (the expected return per step, by contrast, is exactly equal). The optimal fixed fraction is given by $\max_f \mathbb{E}\log(1+f\,r)$; when $\sigma\sqrt{\Delta}$ is small, $f^*\approx\mu/\sigma^2$ (second-order approximation, risk-free rate taken as 0, $\Delta$ is the length of one step), and heavy tails and negative skew make it smaller. When the distribution has no lower bound, strictly speaking any $f>1$ loses everything in a single step with positive probability: with the normal this probability is too small to see, with Student-t it really does occur in the simulation.

zh: 两点分布下 Kelly 问题有闭式解：每步涨 $a$ 的概率为 $q$、跌 $c$ 的概率为 $1-q$ 时，$f^*=q/c-(1-q)/a$（无风险利率为 0）。要求 $a>0$、$c>0$，即涨和跌分居无风险收益的两侧；否则是套利，$f^*$ 无界。
en: For a two-point distribution the Kelly problem has a closed-form solution: if each step goes up by $a$ with probability $q$ and down by $c$ with probability $1-q$, then $f^*=q/c-(1-q)/a$ (with a risk-free rate of 0). This requires $a>0$ and $c>0$, that is, the up move and the down move lie on opposite sides of the risk-free return; otherwise there is an arbitrage and $f^*$ is unbounded.

zh: 每一次以概率 p 赢得 b 倍赌注，否则输掉赌注。仓位 f 就是每次押上的资金比例。
en: On each flip you win b times your stake with probability p and otherwise lose the stake. The position f is the fraction of your capital that you stake each time.

zh: 胜率 p
en: Win probability p

zh: 赔率 b（赢时净得 b 倍）
en: Odds b (a win nets b times the stake)

zh: Kelly (1956)：最大化每次的对数增长率 $g(f)=p\log(1+bf)+(1-p)\log(1-f)$，解得 $f^*=p-(1-p)/b$。
en: Kelly (1956): maximizing the log growth rate per flip $g(f)=p\log(1+bf)+(1-p)\log(1-f)$ gives $f^*=p-(1-p)/b$.

zh: §0§按当前参数 $f^*\le 0$：这个赌局的期望不为正，最优是一分不押。
en: §0§ With the current parameters, $f^*\le 0$: the expectation of this bet is not positive, and the optimum is to bet nothing.

zh: §0§增长率在 $f=§1§$ 处回到 0，再多就是负的（二阶近似下这个点是 $2f^*=§2§$；胜率低于一半时精确的零点略大于 $2f^*$，高于一半时略小，恰为一半时正好是 $2f^*$）。$f=1$ 时第一次输就归零。
en: §0§ The growth rate returns to 0 at $f=§1§$ and is negative beyond that (in the second-order approximation this point is $2f^*=§2§$; the exact zero is slightly above $2f^*$ when the win probability is below one half, slightly below it when the win probability is above one half, and exactly $2f^*$ when it is exactly one half). At $f=1$ the first loss takes wealth to zero.

zh: 每一步的对数收益互相独立、服从同一个正态分布：平均每年涨 μ，波动每年 σ。写成公式是 dS/S = μ dt + σ dW，Black–Scholes 期权定价用的就是这个模型。
en: The log returns of the steps are independent and follow the same normal distribution: the price rises by μ per year on average, with volatility σ per year. As a formula, dS/S = μ dt + σ dW; this is the model used in Black–Scholes option pricing.

zh: Merton (1969)：连续再平衡、对数效用下最优仓位恒为 $f^*=(\mu-r_f)/\sigma^2$，增长率 $g(f)=r_f+f(\mu-r_f)-f^2\sigma^2/2$，峰值 $g^*=r_f+(\mu-r_f)^2/(2\sigma^2)$（$r_f$ 是无风险利率，按年）。按天再平衡时曲线略有偏离；严格地说，离散调仓下 $f>1$ 或 $f<0$ 都有正概率一步亏光（这时 $\mathbb{E}\log$ 是 $-\infty$），只是概率小到模拟里看不见。
en: Merton (1969): with continuous rebalancing and log utility the optimal position is the constant $f^*=(\mu-r_f)/\sigma^2$, the growth rate is $g(f)=r_f+f(\mu-r_f)-f^2\sigma^2/2$, and its peak is $g^*=r_f+(\mu-r_f)^2/(2\sigma^2)$ ($r_f$ is the risk-free rate, per year). With daily rebalancing the curve deviates slightly; strictly speaking, under discrete rebalancing both $f>1$ and $f<0$ lose everything in a single step with positive probability (in which case $\mathbb{E}\log$ is $-\infty$), but the probability is too small to be seen in the simulation.

zh: 对数价格 X 满足 dX = κ(ln θ − X) dt + σ dW，被一根弹簧拉回均衡价 θ。物理上就是过阻尼朗之万方程。
en: The log price X satisfies dX = κ(ln θ − X) dt + σ dW: a spring pulls it back to the equilibrium price θ. In physics this is the overdamped Langevin equation.

zh: 半衰期 = ln2/κ 年
en: Half-life = ln2/κ years

zh: 起始价
en: Starting price

zh: 记 $X$ 为对数价格，$\Delta$ 为一步的时长。条件期望已知：$\mathbb{E}[\Delta X\mid X]=(\ln\theta-X)(1-e^{-\kappa\Delta})$。对数效用的投资者是短视的，最优仓位 $f_t=(\kappa(\ln\theta-X_t)+\sigma^2/2-r_f)/\sigma^2$（$r_f$ 是无风险利率），随偏离线性变化；有交易成本时最优策略变成在一条"不交易带"外才调仓。$X$ 的平稳标准差为 $\sigma/\sqrt{2\kappa}$。
en: Let $X$ be the log price and $\Delta$ the length of one step. The conditional expectation is known: $\mathbb{E}[\Delta X\mid X]=(\ln\theta-X)(1-e^{-\kappa\Delta})$. An investor with log utility is myopic, and the optimal position is $f_t=(\kappa(\ln\theta-X_t)+\sigma^2/2-r_f)/\sigma^2$ ($r_f$ is the risk-free rate), which varies linearly with the deviation; with trading costs the optimal strategy becomes rebalancing only outside a "no-trade band". The stationary standard deviation of $X$ is $\sigma/\sqrt{2\kappa}$.

zh: GBM 之上叠加泊松到达的跳跃，跳幅对数正态。漂移已做补偿，期望收益仍是 μ。
en: Jumps with Poisson arrivals are added on top of GBM, with lognormal jump sizes. The drift is compensated, so the expected return is still μ.

zh: 扩散波动 σ
en: Diffusion volatility σ

zh: 跳跃强度 λ
en: Jump intensity λ

zh: 对数跳幅的均值
en: Mean of the log jump size

zh: 每次跳跃价格乘以 J，ln J 服从正态分布；这是 ln J 的均值
en: At each jump the price is multiplied by J, and ln J is normally distributed; this is the mean of ln J

zh: 对数跳幅的标准差
en: Standard deviation of the log jump size

zh: 有跳跃时 Merton 比例 $(\mu-r)/\sigma^2$ 不再最优：最优仓位要解 $g(f)=r+f(\mu-\lambda k-r)-f^2\sigma^2/2+\lambda\,\mathbb{E}\log(1+f(J-1))$ 的一阶条件（$r$ 是无风险利率，$J$ 是跳跃时价格乘上的倍数，$k=\mathbb{E}[J-1]$，现在是 §0§%），向下的跳跃会把它压低。
en: With jumps the Merton fraction $(\mu-r)/\sigma^2$ is no longer optimal: the optimal position solves the first-order condition of $g(f)=r+f(\mu-\lambda k-r)-f^2\sigma^2/2+\lambda\,\mathbb{E}\log(1+f(J-1))$ ($r$ is the risk-free rate, $J$ is the factor by which the price is multiplied at a jump, and $k=\mathbb{E}[J-1]$, currently §0§%), and downward jumps push it lower.

zh: 现在跳跃的频率 $\lambda$ 是 0：这个世界退化成几何布朗运动，最优仓位就是 Merton 比例 $(\mu-r)/\sigma^2$（$r$ 是无风险利率）。把 $\lambda$ 调大，才看得到跳跃的影响。
en: The jump frequency $\lambda$ is currently 0: this world reduces to geometric Brownian motion, and the optimal position is the Merton fraction $(\mu-r)/\sigma^2$ ($r$ is the risk-free rate). You have to raise $\lambda$ to see the effect of the jumps.

zh: 跳幅对数正态时 $J-1$ 可以任意接近 −100%，也可以任意大，所以严格地说可行的仓位只有 $0\le f\le 1$：$f>1$ 时一次足够大的下跳就会让净值归零，这时 $\mathbb{E}\log$ 是 $-\infty$。
en: With lognormal jump sizes, $J-1$ can come arbitrarily close to −100% and can also be arbitrarily large, so strictly speaking the only feasible positions are $0\le f\le 1$: for $f>1$ a single sufficiently large downward jump takes wealth to zero, and then $\mathbb{E}\log$ is $-\infty$.
The current parameters give $g'(1)=§0§§1§

zh: >0$，$g$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上单调上升，严格的最优解是 $f^*=1$。
en: >0$, so $g$ is monotonically increasing on $[0,1]$ and, strictly speaking, the optimum is $f^*=1$.
<0$, so the optimum lies inside $[0,1)$.

zh: $f=2$ 时一次跳跃就致命的概率并不小，模拟的杠杆曲线在 1 以上很快就会出现破产路径。
en: At $f=2$ the probability that a single jump is fatal is not small, and ruined paths soon appear above 1 on the simulated leverage curve.

zh: 模拟的杠杆曲线仍可能在 1 以上出峰：$f=2$ 时一次跳跃致命的概率只有约 §0§，样本里遇不到。
en: The simulated leverage curve may still peak above 1: at $f=2$ the probability that a single jump is fatal is only about §0§, so the sample never encounters one.

zh: $f=2$ 时一次跳跃致命的概率约 §0§：路径多、时间长时样本里会碰上，那时增长率直接变成 $-\infty$。
en: At $f=2$ the probability that a single jump is fatal is about §0§: with many paths and a long horizon the sample will encounter one, and the growth rate then becomes $-\infty$ outright.

zh: 方差 v 自己也是一个均值回复过程：dv = κ(θ − v)dt + ξ√v dW'，与价格的布朗运动相关系数为 ρ。
en: The variance v is itself a mean-reverting process: dv = κ(θ − v)dt + ξ√v dW', and its Brownian motion has correlation ρ with that of the price.

zh: 长期波动 √θ
en: Long-run volatility √θ

zh: 方差回复速度 κ
en: Variance reversion speed κ

zh: 波动的波动 ξ
en: Volatility of volatility ξ

zh: 2κθ > ξ² 时方差碰不到 0（Feller 条件）
en: When 2κθ > ξ² the variance never reaches 0 (the Feller condition)

zh: 相关系数 ρ
en: Correlation ρ

zh: 对数效用下最优仓位仍是短视的：$f_t=(\mu-r_f)/v_t$，与方差成反比；"波动率目标"（与标准差成反比）方向相同、反应不足。这个结论要求 $\mathbb{E}\int(\mu-r_f)^2/v_t\,dt<\infty$，在 Heston 模型里即 $2\kappa\theta>\xi^2$。当前参数 $2\kappa\theta=§0§$，$\xi^2=§1§$§2§按步观测时 $v_t$ 不能直接看到，只能用已实现波动去估计。
en: With log utility the optimal position is still myopic: $f_t=(\mu-r_f)/v_t$, inversely proportional to the variance; "Volatility targeting" (inversely proportional to the standard deviation) moves in the same direction but under-reacts. This result requires $\mathbb{E}\int(\mu-r_f)^2/v_t\,dt<\infty$, which in the Heston model means $2\kappa\theta>\xi^2$. The current parameters give $2\kappa\theta=§0§$ and $\xi^2=§1§$§2§ When you observe step by step, $v_t$ cannot be seen directly and can only be estimated from realized volatility.

zh: ，条件成立。
en: , so the condition holds.

zh: ，条件不成立：$v_t$ 会贴到 0 附近，连续时间里的最优增长率发散，这里靠仓位上限挡住。
en: , so the condition fails: $v_t$ sticks close to 0, the optimal growth rate in continuous time diverges, and here it is held back by the position cap.

zh: σ²ₜ₊₁ = ω + α·ε²ₜ + β·σ²ₜ。收益本身不相关，但波动有记忆：大波动之后跟着大波动。
en: σ²ₜ₊₁ = ω + α·ε²ₜ + β·σ²ₜ. The returns themselves are uncorrelated, but volatility has memory: high volatility is followed by high volatility.

zh: 长期波动
en: Long-run volatility

zh: α（对冲击的反应）
en: α (reaction to shocks)

zh: β（波动的惯性）
en: β (persistence of volatility)

zh: α + β 要小于 1，方差才收得住：两者之和超过 0.995 时，β 按 0.995 − α 算
en: The sum α + β must be below 1 for the variance to stay finite: when it exceeds 0.995, β is taken as 0.995 − α

zh: 收益的方向不可预测，但波动可预测：条件方差 $\sigma_t^2$ 由过去的冲击决定。短视的对数最优仓位约为 $\mu\Delta/\sigma_t^2$（无风险利率取 0，$\Delta$ 是一步的时长），所以按条件方差的倒数调仓能提高增长率（按波动的倒数调仓，即波动率目标，方向相同、反应不足）；$\alpha>0$ 时无条件分布比正态厚尾（峰度大于 3）。
en: The direction of returns is unpredictable, but volatility is predictable: the conditional variance $\sigma_t^2$ is determined by past shocks. The myopic log-optimal position is approximately $\mu\Delta/\sigma_t^2$ (risk-free rate taken as 0, $\Delta$ is the length of one step), so rebalancing the position in proportion to the inverse of the conditional variance raises the growth rate (rebalancing in proportion to the inverse of volatility, that is, volatility targeting, moves in the same direction but under-reacts); when $\alpha>0$ the unconditional distribution has heavier tails than the normal (kurtosis above 3).

zh: 市场在牛、熊两个不可见的状态之间按马尔可夫链切换，每个状态有自己的漂移和波动。物理上叫随机电报噪声。
en: The market switches between two unobservable states, bull and bear, according to a Markov chain, and each state has its own drift and volatility. In physics this is called random telegraph noise.

zh: 牛市漂移
en: Bull-market drift

zh: 牛市波动
en: Bull-market volatility

zh: 熊市漂移
en: Bear-market drift

zh: 熊市波动
en: Bear-market volatility

zh: 牛市平均时长
en: Average bull-market duration

zh: 熊市平均时长
en: Average bear-market duration

zh: 状态不可见，只能由收益序列做贝叶斯滤波（隐马尔可夫的前向算法；连续时间、各状态波动相同时对应 Wonham 滤波）得到牛市的后验概率 $\pi_t$。对数最优仓位用滤波后的条件矩：$f_t\approx\mathbb{E}[r\mid\mathcal{F}_t]/\operatorname{Var}[r\mid\mathcal{F}_t]$（$\mathcal{F}_t$ 是到 $t$ 时刻为止看到的全部收益；无风险利率取 0）。两个状态的波动不同时，波动的大小本身也在泄露状态。动量规则之所以在这里有效，是因为过去收益携带了状态信息。
en: The state is unobservable; the posterior probability $\pi_t$ of the bull market can only be obtained by Bayesian filtering of the return series (the forward algorithm of a hidden Markov model; in continuous time with the same volatility in every state it corresponds to the Wonham filter). The log-optimal position uses the filtered conditional moments: $f_t\approx\mathbb{E}[r\mid\mathcal{F}_t]/\operatorname{Var}[r\mid\mathcal{F}_t]$ ($\mathcal{F}_t$ is all the returns seen up to time $t$; risk-free rate taken as 0). When the two states have different volatilities, the size of the volatility itself also leaks information about the state. Momentum rules work here because past returns carry information about the state.

zh: rₜ₊₁ − μΔ = φ·(rₜ − μΔ) + 噪声。φ > 0 是动量，φ < 0 是反转。无条件波动固定为 σ。
en: rₜ₊₁ − μΔ = φ·(rₜ − μΔ) + noise. φ > 0 is momentum, φ < 0 is reversal. The unconditional volatility is fixed at σ.

zh: 自相关 φ
en: Autocorrelation φ

zh: 条件期望 $\mathbb{E}[r_{t+1}\mid r_t]=\mu\Delta+\varphi(r_t-\mu\Delta)$，条件方差 $\sigma^2\Delta(1-\varphi^2)$（$\Delta$ 是一步的时长）。短视的对数最优仓位 $f_t\approx\mathbb{E}[r_{t+1}\mid r_t]/\operatorname{Var}[r_{t+1}\mid r_t]$（二阶近似，无风险利率取 0）：对最近一步收益线性反应。可预测的比例只有 $R^2=\varphi^2$，现在是 §0§%。
en: The conditional expectation is $\mathbb{E}[r_{t+1}\mid r_t]=\mu\Delta+\varphi(r_t-\mu\Delta)$ and the conditional variance is $\sigma^2\Delta(1-\varphi^2)$ ($\Delta$ is the length of one step). The myopic log-optimal position is $f_t\approx\mathbb{E}[r_{t+1}\mid r_t]/\operatorname{Var}[r_{t+1}\mid r_t]$ (second-order approximation, risk-free rate taken as 0): it responds linearly to the return of the most recent step. The predictable fraction is only $R^2=\varphi^2$, currently §0§%.

zh: 对数价格是 Hurst 指数为 H 的分数布朗运动：H > ½ 时增量正相关（趋势持续），H < ½ 时负相关（来回震荡），H = ½ 退化为普通布朗运动。
en: The log price is a fractional Brownian motion with Hurst exponent H: for H > ½ the increments are positively correlated (trends persist), for H < ½ they are negatively correlated (the path oscillates back and forth), and at H = ½ it reduces to ordinary Brownian motion.

zh: 单步波动（年化）
en: One-step volatility (annualized)

zh: 增量的自协方差 $\gamma(k)=\tfrac12(|k+1|^{2H}-2|k|^{2H}+|k-1|^{2H})$，相邻两步的相关系数为 $2^{2H-1}-1=§0§$，且按 $H(2H-1)\,k^{2H-2}$ 的幂律衰减：$H>\tfrac12$ 时不可和（长记忆），$H<\tfrac12$ 时 $k\ne 0$ 的项全为负、可和，并且 $\sum_{k\in\mathbb{Z}}\gamma(k)=0$（负相关正好抵掉 $\gamma(0)=1$；反持续）。$H\ne\tfrac12$ 时它不是半鞅：理论上存在套利，现实中被交易成本吃掉。最优线性预测要用到全部历史，而不只是最近一步。这里的 $\mu$ 是对数价格的漂移：$H=\tfrac12$ 时，这个世界就是漂移取 $\mu+\sigma^2/2$ 的 GBM 世界。
en: The autocovariance of the increments is $\gamma(k)=\tfrac12(|k+1|^{2H}-2|k|^{2H}+|k-1|^{2H})$; the correlation between adjacent steps is $2^{2H-1}-1=§0§$, and the autocovariance decays as the power law $H(2H-1)\,k^{2H-2}$: for $H>\tfrac12$ it is not summable (long memory); for $H<\tfrac12$ the terms with $k\ne 0$ are all negative and summable, and $\sum_{k\in\mathbb{Z}}\gamma(k)=0$ (the negative correlations exactly cancel $\gamma(0)=1$; anti-persistence). For $H\ne\tfrac12$ it is not a semimartingale: in theory arbitrage exists, in practice it is eaten up by trading costs. The optimal linear prediction uses the entire history, not only the most recent step. Here $\mu$ is the drift of the log price: at $H=\tfrac12$ this world is the GBM world with drift $\mu+\sigma^2/2$.

zh: xₜ₊₁ = a·xₜ(1 − xₜ)。a = 4 时序列看起来像白噪声（线性自相关为零），但下一步完全由当前值决定。价格 = 100·exp(v·标准化的 x)。
en: xₜ₊₁ = a·xₜ(1 − xₜ). At a = 4 the series looks like white noise (zero linear autocorrelation), yet the next step is completely determined by the current value. Price = 100·exp(v·standardized x).

zh: a > 3.5699… 之后以混沌为主，中间夹着周期窗口（如 a ≈ 3.83 的周期 3）；a = 4 时不变密度是反正弦分布
en: For a > 3.5699… chaos dominates, interspersed with periodic windows (such as period 3 near a ≈ 3.83); at a = 4 the invariant density is the arcsine distribution

zh: 观测噪声（x 的标准差倍数）
en: Observation noise (in standard deviations of x)

zh: 价格灵敏度 v
en: Price sensitivity v

zh: x 每变化 1 个标准差，价格变化 v%
en: For each change of 1 standard deviation in x, the price changes by v%

zh: $a=4$ 时 $x$ 的自相关在所有非零滞后上恰好为 0：用线性模型预测下一个 $x$，$R^2$ 是 0，它看起来就是白噪声。但价格是 $x$ 的水平而不是 $x$ 的累加，所以"下一步收益"是水平的增量：用当前水平对水平的增量做线性回归，$R^2$ 恰好是 $\tfrac12$（对简单收益则约为 $\tfrac12$，$v=2\%$ 时是 0.496），这只是"白噪声的水平会回到均值"。真实的条件期望是抛物线 $\mathbb{E}[x_{t+1}\mid x_t]=4x_t(1-x_t)$，能拟合非线性的模型（k 近邻、树、神经网络）可以把 $R^2$ 从 $\tfrac12$ 提到 1。Lyapunov 指数为 $\ln 2$：预测误差每步翻倍，所以只能预测很短的未来。
en: At $a=4$ the autocorrelation of $x$ is exactly 0 at every nonzero lag: predicting the next $x$ with a linear model gives an $R^2$ of 0, and it looks just like white noise. But the price is the level of $x$, not the cumulative sum of $x$, so the "next-step return" is the increment of the level: a linear regression of the increment of the level on the current level has $R^2$ exactly $\tfrac12$ (for simple returns it is approximately $\tfrac12$; it is 0.496 when $v=2\%$), and this is only "the level of white noise returns to its mean". The true conditional expectation is the parabola $\mathbb{E}[x_{t+1}\mid x_t]=4x_t(1-x_t)$, and models that can fit nonlinearity (k-nearest neighbors, trees, neural networks) can raise $R^2$ from $\tfrac12$ to 1. The Lyapunov exponent is $\ln 2$: the prediction error doubles at every step, so only a very short future can be predicted.

zh: ẋ = 10(y − x)，ẏ = x(28 − z) − y，ż = xy − 8z/3。每隔 τ 采样一次 x，价格 = 100·exp(v·x/σₓ)。
en: ẋ = 10(y − x), ẏ = x(28 − z) − y, ż = xy − 8z/3. Here x is sampled at intervals of τ, and price = 100·exp(v·x/σₓ).

zh: τ 越大，相邻两个采样点之间的关系越非线性
en: The larger τ is, the more nonlinear the relation between adjacent sample points

zh: 观测噪声（σₓ 的倍数）
en: Observation noise (multiples of σₓ)

zh: 三维确定性系统只观测一个分量。Takens 嵌入定理及其推广（Sauer–Yorke–Casdagli 1991）：用足够多的滞后坐标 $(x_t,x_{t-1},\dots,x_{t-m+1})$ 可以重构吸引子（坐标的个数 $m>2d$ 就够，$d$ 是吸引子的盒维数；洛伦兹吸引子 $d\approx 2.06$，所以 5 个滞后一定够，实际上 3 个通常就行），所以"滞后特征 + 非参数模型"是这里的正确做法（Farmer–Sidorowich 1987）。最大 Lyapunov 指数约 0.906/单位时间，可预测的时间尺度约为 1/0.906。
en: A three-dimensional deterministic system of which only one component is observed. Takens' embedding theorem and its generalization (Sauer–Yorke–Casdagli 1991): with enough lagged coordinates $(x_t,x_{t-1},\dots,x_{t-m+1})$ the attractor can be reconstructed (a number of coordinates $m>2d$ is enough, where $d$ is the box-counting dimension of the attractor; for the Lorenz attractor $d\approx 2.06$, so 5 lags are certainly enough and in practice 3 usually suffice), so "lagged features + a nonparametric model" is the right approach here (Farmer–Sidorowich 1987). The largest Lyapunov exponent is about 0.906 per unit time, and the predictable time scale is about 1/0.906.

zh: 被随机力推动的欠阻尼振子的离散时间版本，一个 AR(2)：xₜ = 2ρcos(ω)·xₜ₋₁ − ρ²·xₜ₋₂ + εₜ（对连续时间的振子等间隔采样，严格地说得到 ARMA(2,1)，自回归部分相同）。价格 = 100·exp(v·x/σₓ)。
en: The discrete-time version of an underdamped oscillator driven by a random force, an AR(2): xₜ = 2ρcos(ω)·xₜ₋₁ − ρ²·xₜ₋₂ + εₜ (sampling the continuous-time oscillator at equal intervals gives, strictly speaking, an ARMA(2,1) with the same autoregressive part). Price = 100·exp(v·x/σₓ).

zh: 越接近 1 阻尼越小，周期越清晰
en: The closer to 1, the weaker the damping and the clearer the cycle

zh: 线性高斯过程，最优预测就是线性的：$\mathbb{E}[x_{t+1}\mid\text{过去}]=\varphi_1x_t+\varphi_2x_{t-1}$，其中 $\varphi_1=2\rho\cos(2\pi/\text{周期})=§0§$，$\varphi_2=-\rho^2=§1§$。两个滞后的线性回归是正确设定，更复杂的模型只会增加估计噪声。有观测噪声时最优预测变成卡尔曼滤波。
en: A linear Gaussian process, so the optimal prediction is linear: $\mathbb{E}[x_{t+1}\mid\text{past}]=\varphi_1x_t+\varphi_2x_{t-1}$, where $\varphi_1=2\rho\cos(2\pi/\text{period})=§0§$ and $\varphi_2=-\rho^2=§1§$. A linear regression on two lags is correctly specified, and more complex models only add estimation noise. With observation noise the optimal prediction becomes the Kalman filter.

zh: 用导入的历史序列回测。前一段做训练，后一段留作样本外。
en: Backtest on an imported historical series. The earlier part is used for training and the later part is held out as out-of-sample.

zh: 用法
en: Usage

zh: 整段历史当一条路径
en: The whole history as one path

zh: 滚动窗口（每个起点一条路径）
en: Rolling windows (one path per starting point)

zh: 窗口长度（步）
en: Window length (steps)

zh: 窗口间隔（步）
en: Window spacing (steps)

zh: 真实数据的分布未知，没有"最优"可言，只能问样本外是否还成立。滚动窗口之间高度重叠，标准误会被低估，只适合看分布的形状。
en: The distribution of real data is unknown, so there is no "optimum" to speak of; you can only ask whether a result still holds out-of-sample. Rolling windows overlap heavily, so the standard error is underestimated, and they are only suitable for looking at the shape of the distribution.

zh: 把导入序列训练段的收益率按块重新抽样拼成新路径（平稳 bootstrap）：保留真实的收益分布和短程相关，打乱长程结构。
en: The returns of the imported series' training segment are resampled in blocks and joined into new paths (the stationary bootstrap): this keeps the real return distribution and the short-range correlation, and scrambles the long-range structure.

zh: 平均块长（步）
en: Average block length (steps)

zh: 块长为 1 时完全打乱时间顺序，等于假设收益独立同分布
en: With a block length of 1 the time order is shuffled completely, which amounts to assuming that returns are i.i.d.

zh: Politis–Romano (1994) 平稳 bootstrap：块长服从几何分布，重采样序列仍然平稳。块长 1 的结果与真实历史的差距，度量了"时间顺序"本身贡献了多少收益。
en: The Politis–Romano (1994) stationary bootstrap: block lengths follow a geometric distribution, and the resampled series is still stationary. The gap between the result with block length 1 and the real history measures how much of the return is contributed by the "time order" itself.

zh: 由一段 simulate(T, rng, p) 函数生成每条路径的价格。
en: A simulate(T, rng, p) function generates the prices of each path.

zh: 训练段只有 §0§ 个点，不够再分出一段给模型训练（至少 60 个）。把"训练占比"调大，或者导入更长的数据。
en: The training segment has only §0§ points, too few to set a further part aside for training the model (at least 60 are needed). Increase "Training share", or import a longer series.

zh: 未知的世界类型: §0§
en: Unknown world type: §0§

zh: bootstrap 需要先导入一段真实数据
en: The bootstrap requires importing a real data series first

zh: 自定义世界缺少 simulate(T, rng, p) 函数
en: The custom world is missing its simulate(T, rng, p) function

zh: simulate 必须返回长度为 T+1 的价格数组（现在返回的长度是 §0§）
en: simulate must return a price array of length T+1 (the length returned now is §0§)

zh: simulate 返回的第 §0§ 个价格不是有限正数: §1§
en: The price at index §0§ returned by simulate is not a finite positive number: §1§

zh: 请先导入一段真实数据（至少 30 个点）
en: Import a real data series first (at least 30 points)

zh: 这一段数据太短，无法回测
en: This segment of data is too short to backtest

zh: 世界还没生成
en: The world has not been generated yet
